subject: Two stable bridge repros: sampler_index range and swizzle_valid
body:
Independent suite now runs against metal/nord2_metal_bridge.c sha256 52f00fec...; no transient build errors. ABI oracle passes corrected layout resource160/descriptor64/region1172/NativeDispatchV2 11496; TGP2 parser 156 checks pass; real Rust planner 38/38 on real AIR fixtures; full job decode passes COMPUTE_JOB/SHADER_PROGRAM/LOCAL_STORAGE/FAU/SRT/Mesa golden.

REQUIRED REPRO 1 (sampler_index range): build package TGP2 with combined texture+sampler at native binding5, both manifest records flagged TEGU_PIPELINE2_FLAG_DECLARED_COMBINED. Dispatch wire descriptor kind6 binding5, sampler_index=99, otherwise valid inline sampler state. Call n2mb_method(dev,7,&pipeline,1,wire,6304,...). Actual: returns0 and submits; expected: nonzero/no submit because planner Metal sampler namespace is 0..15 (air_bridge.rs compute_state rejects index>=16). Current bridge never reads TEGU_PIPELINE_D2_SAMPLER_INDEX (grep count 0), so combined sampler identity is unvalidated. Repro is tests/test_swizzle? no: worker file n2mb_v2_job_test.c test_refusals case 'combined descriptor accepts sampler_index 99 outside 0..15'. Owner: compute (nord2_metal_bridge.c). Please validate sampler_index<=15 and, for combined, that it identifies a bound/valid sampler class.

REQUIRED REPRO 2 (swizzle silently dropped): dispatch sampled texture binding3 with TEGU_PIPELINE_D2_SWIZZLE=0x210 (RRR? bits), valid 16x16 RGBA8/span. Actual success; table1[3] descriptor word2 low12 bits = 0x688 (format default identity). Cause: nord2_metal_bridge.c:410 sets l.swizzle_word but never l.swizzle_valid; n2t_swizzle_word uses swizzle_valid?swizzle_word:default. Textures explicitly asked for l.swizzle_valid=(swizzle_word!=0). Current Rust planner only emits 0/0x688, so latent for today's plans but still a silent semantics loss; please set swizzle_valid from the wire or refuse a nonzero word if not representable. Repro: n2mb_v2_job_test.c test_swizzle_and_atomic.

Not defects (verified/withdrawn): (a) the old C/Rust region/descriptor size mismatch is fixed in current source and the generated ABI oracle passes; (b) I initially flagged OFFSET+LEVEL_OFFSET double application, then verified runtime_pipeline.inc writes OFFSET=range_offset and LEVEL_OFFSET=0; the valid split passes (plane exactly backing+offset) and is now a required positive check; (c) view_level/view_layer remain informational, no current defect claim.

Current suite result: 440 checks, 2 required failures (the above), 0 pending, ABI/producer PASS. Files gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py + workers/integration_tests/{abi_oracle.py,tgp2_contract_test.c,n2mb_v2_job_test.c,producer_plan_test.py,STATUS.md}. No commit/device/native build.
